meta.title: Cadence
meta.description: Local-first medical ID and daily medication cadence. Your data stays on this device.

footer.privacy: Cadence never sends your health data to a server. Everything lives in this browser and, if you choose, in a URL hash you control.
footer.lgpd: Single-user tool. No doctor or patient accounts. Built to respect LGPD.

profile.title: Your medical ID
profile.lead: Fill in what a first responder or pharmacist would need. Cadence saves automatically on this device.
profile.advancedHint: Shows extra fields such as document ID, body measurements, and your clinician.
profile.notesPlaceholder: Anything else a responder should know.
profile.resetConfirm: Clear the medical ID saved on this device? This cannot be undone.

schedule.title: Daily schedule
schedule.lead: Medications grouped by morning, afternoon, evening, and bedtime. Check-offs will land here.
schedule.empty: Add medications with time slots on your profile to see a timetable.
schedule.placeholder: Compliance check-offs, MiniSearch, and sponsor slots plug into this page.

emergency.title: Emergency view
emergency.lead: High-contrast summary for first responders. Share only what you intend to share.
emergency.warning: A shareable emergency link puts health data in the URL. Anyone with the link can read it. Prefer the emergency-only payload.
emergency.copyFailed: Could not copy. Copy the address bar instead.
emergency.empty: No profile loaded. Open your profile or a #data= link.
emergency.placeholder: QR share and AAA contrast refinements plug into this page.

print.title: Print and PDF
print.lead: Wallet card and daily intake templates will render from the same profile and glyphs.
print.templateA: Template A — foldable wallet card (3.375 × 2.125 in), two-sided, allergy badge, emergency QR.
print.templateB: Template B — A4 / Letter daily intake grouped Morning / Afternoon / Evening / Bedtime.
print.placeholder: jsPDF generation plugs into this page. Nothing leaves the device.
